subject.appearance: Summary of looks: face shape/features/age and presence, etc. (excluding full body shape; body shape goes in the fields below)
subject.body_type: Overall body type: height impression + build/curve type, e.g. tall and slender, petite and well-proportioned, full and curvy, athletic and toned
subject.body_proportions: Proportion impression: head-to-body ratio, leg-length ratio, shoulder width vs. hip width, high or low waistline
subject.body_details: By body part: shoulders/neck/collarbones, rib cage contour, waist/abdomen, hips/glutes, leg shape, arm lines (only what is visible; do not invent)
subject.posture_habit: Posture seen throughout the video: upright / slight swayback / rounded shoulders / S-curve / relaxed forward lean, etc.

outfit.summary: One-sentence overall outfit that must include colors and styles, e.g. white fitted short-sleeve shirt + black high-waisted bodycon mini skirt + black pointed-toe stilettos
outfit.style: Outfit style tag: office/OL, sweet floral, sporty casual, swimwear, JK uniform, streetwear, loungewear, etc.
outfit.palette: Main color + secondary color + accents, e.g. white + black + silver accessories

items.name: Short-sleeve collared shirt
items.style: Fitted, collar buttoned, sleeves rolled to mid-forearm
items.material: Visible material, e.g. cotton/satin sheen; if not visible, write none

outfit.change: none / at t=x.x changes from A to B

scene.location: Location type, e.g. stairwell corridor, bedroom, pedestrian shopping street; do not invent landmark names that are not visible
scene.space: Spatial structure: long narrow corridor / open plaza / low cramped corner, etc.
scene.subject_placement: Subject's position and facing direction, e.g. against the right wall, half a step from the door, facing the camera
scene.background: Background layer: color + material + main elements
scene.foreground: Foreground occlusion or close-range objects; write none if absent
scene.time_weather: Time of day and weather (only if visible)
scene.ambient_light: Position of light sources in the space: ceiling lights/window light/neon, etc.; distinct from camera-side lighting setup
scene.atmosphere: Character of the space: cool gray office corridor / cozy bedroom / bustling street, etc.
scene.changes: single continuous scene / timestamps of scene cuts

camera.device_feel: Device and stabilization feel: vertical phone video / gimbal / slight handheld shake / cinematic look, etc.
camera.height: Camera height: eye level / slightly low / low angle / slightly high / high angle
camera.angle: Horizontal angle: frontal / 3/4 side / full profile / slight over-the-shoulder, etc.
camera.framing: Main shot size + composition: full body centered / knee-up shot on the rule of thirds, etc.
camera.movement: Main camera movement: static/truck/push in/pull out/follow/orbit/crane + speed and path
camera.movement_rhythm: Camera movement vs. rhythm: constant speed / brief hold on strong beats / follow move on weak beats / not tied to rhythm
camera.depth_of_field: Depth of field and in-focus subject: full body sharp / background slightly soft / face in focus, etc.
camera.focus_priority: Focal emphasis for the whole video: primary focus + secondary focus (full-body proportions/legs and feet/waist and hips/hand gestures/face/clothing/environment)
camera.shot_method: Shooting method summary in 2-4 sentences: how it is filmed, camera position and stabilization, what it aims to highlight

segments.action: Limbs: left/right limbs / amplitude / hand shape / gaze
segments.expression: Brows/eyes/mouth + emotion; change relative to the previous segment (shifts from A to B, or stays the same)
segments.body_focus: Body/posture focus highlighted in this segment, e.g. side profile showing a slim waist and long legs; if none, write full-body proportions maintained
segments.shot_size: Shot size for this segment: full body / knee-up / waist-up / medium close-up / close-up, etc.
segments.camera_move: Camera movement for this segment: static/push/pull/follow/truck, etc.; if unchanged, write same as whole video
segments.shot_focus: Focal emphasis for this segment: face/hands/legs and feet/waist and hips/full body/clothing/environment
segments.outfit_note: same as whole video / outfit change or clothing state change in this segment
segments.scene_note: same as whole video / scene change in this segment
segments.beat_hint: Optional: aligned beat timestamp in seconds or strong/weak beat note (filled in during the fusion stage)

audio_guess.bgm_style: The visual agent may make a rough guess; rhythm_analysis / rhythm_plan ultimately takes precedence
